company_profile.industry: Global information technology, consulting, and outsourcing services.
key_risks: Intense competition in the global IT services market.
Talent attraction and retention, leading to high attrition rates.
Currency fluctuations and geopolitical risks impacting global operations.
Rapid technological changes requiring continuous upskilling and adaptation.

facts.value: Global information technology, consulting, and outsourcing services.
facts.rationale: Infosys is widely known as a major player in the IT services industry.
Infosys is a publicly traded multinational corporation with significant global operations and revenue.
Infosys is one of the largest IT employers globally, with hundreds of thousands of employees.

facts.value: Headquartered in India, with a significant global presence across many continents.
facts.rationale: Infosys is an Indian multinational corporation with offices and operations worldwide.

facts.value: Intense competition in the global IT services market.
facts.rationale: The IT services industry is highly competitive with many established players and new entrants.

facts.value: Talent attraction and retention, leading to high attrition rates.
facts.rationale: Skilled IT professionals are in high demand, making talent management a critical risk for large IT firms.

facts.value: Currency fluctuations and geopolitical risks impacting global operations.
facts.rationale: As a global company, Infosys is exposed to exchange rate volatility and political instability in various markets.

facts.value: Rapid technological changes requiring continuous upskilling and adaptation.
facts.rationale: The IT industry evolves quickly, necessitating constant investment in new technologies and employee training.
Typical for an IT services company, most employees work in office environments or remotely on computers.

facts.value: Significant international travel for client engagements and project delivery.
facts.rationale: As a global consulting and services firm, frequent international travel is inherent to many roles.

facts.value: Relatively young workforce, common in the technology sector.
facts.rationale: The IT industry often attracts and retains a younger demographic compared to traditional industries.

facts.value: Global workforce requiring support across multiple time zones, potentially involving shift work.
facts.rationale: To support global clients 24/7, some roles likely involve working non-standard hours or shifts.

exposures.name: In-patient hospitalisation
exposures.rationale: As a very large enterprise with 200,000+ employees globally, in-patient hospitalisation costs will be a significant and unavoidable exposure.

exposures.name: Pre/post-hospitalisation expenses
exposures.rationale: Pre/post-hospitalisation expenses applies to every employer's workforce (baseline exposure).

exposures.name: Treatment abroad
exposures.rationale: Infosys has a significant global presence and its workforce undertakes significant international travel, making treatment abroad a relevant concern.

exposures.name: Preventive health check-ups
exposures.rationale: With a very large global workforce, preventive health check-ups are crucial for maintaining employee well-being and managing long-term health costs.

exposures.name: Wellness programmes
exposures.rationale: For a very large global IT company with a predominantly desk-based workforce, wellness programs can help address sedentary lifestyle issues and improve overall employee health.

exposures.name: Outpatient consultations
exposures.rationale: With a very large global workforce, outpatient consultations will be a frequent and significant healthcare need, especially for a predominantly desk-based workforce.

exposures.name: Chronic conditions
exposures.rationale: Even with a relatively young workforce, a very large global employee base will inevitably include a significant number of individuals with chronic conditions that require ongoing management.

exposures.name: Sum insured exhaustion / multiple claims
exposures.rationale: Given the very large global employee base, there is a higher statistical probability of large or multiple claims leading to sum insured exhaustion.
